newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 10 muni issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 10 muni issues for insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp. said Thursday it qualified for bond insurance the following 10 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--Cupertino Union SD, Calif., $18.25 million General Obligations (GOs) and $8.75 million GO Capital Apperication bonds.
--Croton-Harmon UFSD, N.Y., $1.13 million school district bonds.
--Glen Cove City SD, N.Y., $2.5 million school district bonds.
--Hancock CSD, N.Y., $4.654 million school district bonds
--Port Jefferson SD, N.Y., $2.25 million school district bonds.
--West Genessee CSD, N.Y., $5.97 million school district bonds.
--Port Neches, Texas, $4 million water and sewer revenue bonds.
